A collection of links and documents useful for faculty advising graduate students and stuff assisting faculty.


::: {.resource-card}
### Graduate Handbook
The official handbook covering program requirements, policies, and procedures.

[View Graduate Handbook](handbook/index.html){.btn .btn-primary}
:::

::: {.resource-card}
### Admission System
Review and evaluate graduate applicants through the admission system.

[Visit the Admission System Website](http://go.unl.edu/grad-admit){.btn .btn-primary}
:::

::: {.resource-card}
### Offer Letter Request Form
Submit a request to generate an offer letter for a new or existing student.
See the [Offer Letter](offer-letter.qmd) page for more details.

[Submit Offer Letter Request](https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbyHAvpu_tH0o9gO7aVUkWvyAjfIdNLRA--xH2B9jdLjE8R2g6spRIekLAWOMuSr9ptrMQ/exec){.btn .btn-primary}
:::

::: {.resource-card}
### Funding Prospect Survey
Report the funding status for each graduate student you are currently supporting in the upcoming academic year.

[Submit Funding Prospect Survey](https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbzyhNea_V7bQaQnw_u6R6zon5amTZ_Pv9pOFje_9Xn8S6-_i98ggy11B7zNRjfDlcwp/exec){.btn .btn-primary}
:::

::: {.resource-card}
### Progress Report
Submit your evaluation of each advisee's progress for the current academic year.

[Submit Progress Report](https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbxddpNMGXCWcf2VDLYydbAhO1SJfTt8M5uQpdWJ19H9t_Z2EggouKkk31lokQe4N_AfJw/exec){.btn .btn-primary}
:::

::: {.resource-card}
### Graduate Award Nomination
Nominate a student for the J.B. Hassler Graduate Research Award or the Tomek Outstanding Student Award.

[Submit Award Nomination](https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbxa7hXmOCkZhOEdfNa3gT23Lsm--2WcBTDQEy_qBX-O3TXoO_pQ0bZqVoCAgNmN1bB6hQ/exec){.btn .btn-primary}
